whoItsFor: Creators and developers who want to turn a reference video into a new animated video in the same visual style, and who are comfortable running Claude Code or Codex locally with Node.js, Python, and FFmpeg installed.
useCases: Make a music video or short animation that matches the editing rhythm and look of a reference clip
Produce a narrated comic or explainer in a chosen 2D style such as watercolor, pixel art, or anime cel
Generate a new video from a reference link or file plus a one-line brief, then review and comment on the result

requirements.runtime: Node.js 22.18+, Python 3.10+, FFmpeg, Chrome, and Claude Code or Codex CLI (logged in)
